answer_1.quote: We evaluate our model on three datasets of distinct domains: (1) Reddit/ChangeMyView (Reddit/CMV) for argument generation, (2) Wikiplots for story generation, and (3) New York Times for news article writing.
answer_1.outputs: Long-form paragraphs generated for arguments, stories, and news articles.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we adopt BLEU, ROUGE, and METEOR.

answer_4.quote: We hire two proficient English speakers as human annotators to evaluate model outputs. ... we ask each annotator to choose the better output based on: (1) grammaticality; (2) coherence; (3) content richness and (4) overall quality.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators select the better output according to grammaticality, coherence, content richness, and overall quality.
